preconditions.expression: V >= 1 and all(0 <= u < V for edge in adj for u in edge)
preconditions.description: V is a positive integer, and all vertices in adjacency list are valid indices in [0, V-1].

preconditions.expression: all(len(adj[u]) == len(adj[v]) for u in range(V) for v in adj[u])
preconditions.description: Adjacency list is undirected (each edge appears exactly twice, once in each direction).

postconditions.expression: return_value == 2 and all(deg % 2 == 0 for deg in [len(adj[u]) for u in range(V)]) and any(deg > 0 for deg in [len(adj[u]) for u in range(V)])
postconditions.description: Returns 2 if and only if all vertices have even degree and the graph is non-empty (Eulerian Circuit exists).

postconditions.expression: return_value == 1 and sum(1 for deg in [len(adj[u]) for u in range(V)] if deg % 2 == 1) == 2 and any(deg > 0 for deg in [len(adj[u]) for u in range(V)])
postconditions.description: Returns 1 if and only if exactly two vertices have odd degree and the graph is non-empty (Eulerian Path exists).

postconditions.expression: return_value == 0 and (sum(1 for deg in [len(adj[u]) for u in range(V)] if deg % 2 == 1) != 0 and sum(1 for deg in [len(adj[u]) for u in range(V)] if deg % 2 == 1) != 2 or not any(deg > 0 for deg in [len(adj[u]) for u in range(V)]))
postconditions.description: Returns 0 if the graph has more than two vertices with odd degree or is empty (no Eulerian Path/Circuit exists).
